xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3580: UAT-failure relay has no convergence cap — 65 identical rework feedback files written for PAN-3537 in 12 hours

plan.title: UAT-failure relay has no convergence cap — 65 identical rework feedback files written for PAN-3537 in 12 hours
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The operator aborted a strike on this issue precisely because a precision fix is impossible: a durable UAT-cycle state model needs a schema migration, convergence evaluation needs the write-door delivery path, persistent per-verdict delivery identity must survive the record mirror/restore doors, and notes validation must land at the write door plus every caller. Splitting these into sibling issues would ship a convergence gate with no durable state to evaluate, or a durable anchor no restore path preserves — each half is inert alone. The surface is wide because the state travels through four planes (SQLite cache, journal record, workspace fallback, operator surfaces), not because the change is several features.
metadata.docsJustification: Covered by the docs work item; listed here only because the projected surface spans several doc files.

narratives.Problem: A failed UAT verdict blocks the merge queue, but nothing bounds how many times the pipeline re-drives rework for it. Three gaps are live on main today. (1) relayUatFailureFeedbackPromise dedups only on a process-local Map (src/lib/cloister/uat-failure-feedback.ts:33,80), so a dashboard restart or a record-driven verdict restore re-delivers a verdict already delivered; its trigger at src/lib/review-status.ts:519 is not transition-gated, unlike the test-failure trigger 10 lines above. (2) UAT has no convergence cap — review got one in PAN-3151 (stuckReason 'review-not-converging'), but `git grep uat-not-converging` returns nothing, so a non-converging UAT verdict re-drives forever with no operator handoff. (3) A uatStatus 'failed' write with no notes is accepted at every entry point, and the relay substitutes the literal 'No UAT notes were provided.' (uat-failure-feedback.ts:73) into a section headed '## Failed acceptance criteria' — a rework instruction that names nothing and cannot converge. IMPORTANT CORRECTION, verified at planning time: the 65 identical feedback files observed on PAN-3537 were written by the stall sweeper's action door (resumeWorkAgentWithFeedback, introduced in 681875131f for PAN-3487/3489), NOT by the relay Map. PAN-3551 (bbc8e9fcc7, an ancestor of HEAD) already removed that action door. Do not try to reproduce the flood against current main.
narratives.Proposal: Give UAT the three things review already has, and one thing review does not. (a) A pure convergence module (src/lib/cloister/uat-convergence.ts) exporting UatCycleEntry, uatVerdictAnchor, UAT_CONVERGENCE_MAX_CYCLES = 3, and evaluateUatConvergence — a plain cap, not review's reversal/stall arithmetic, because UAT has no countable finding series. (b) Durable state: schema v65 adds review_status.uat_cycle_history and uat_feedback_anchor, backfilling legacy notesless failed rows with an explicit legacy marker so a restore cannot throw at the hardened write door. (c) The relay dedups on the persisted anchor instead of a Map and passes a dedupKey to messageAgent, so neither a restart nor a keyed re-injection can double-send. (d) deliverUatFailureToWorkAgentHostSide records one cycle per distinct verdict, evaluates convergence, marks stuckReason 'uat-not-converging' at the cap, and the relay then surfaces a needs-you instead of messaging the work agent — mirroring review-verdict-feedback.ts:178-194. (e) setReviewStatusSync throws UatVerdictMissingNotesError for a notesless failed UAT verdict; REST returns 400, the CLI exits non-zero, and the deacon recovery patrol skips-and-nudges rather than crashing. (f) Both new fields are mirrored into the per-issue record and restored from it, and join GATE_COMPANIONS.uatStatus, so a cache rebuild cannot resurrect an already-delivered verdict. (g) Operator surfaces: a PARK_REASONS entry, a pan show cycle series, and a symmetric unstick reset.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not resurrect the stall sweeper's action door; PAN-3551 made stall-sweeper.ts observability-only on purpose and it must stay that way.
- Do not attempt to reproduce the 65-file flood against current main — its writer no longer exists.
- Do not unblock PAN-3537 or delete its accumulated feedback files; that is operational work for the operator.
- Do not change resetPipelineVerdictsForWorkStartSync (src/lib/review-status.ts:659) — it touches no UAT field today.
- Do not bring reviewCycleHistory to restore parity with the new UAT fields; that is a separate change to review's plane.
- Do not port evaluateReviewConvergence's reversal/stall arithmetic to UAT — UAT produces no countable finding series.
- Do not add UAT logic to src/lib/review-status-reconcile.ts; UAT verdicts never arrive through journal reconcile.
- Do not introduce a scoped or partial unstick for the UAT gate; follow the PAN-3151 whole-lifecycle reset precedent.
- Do not write uat_notes into the SQLite cache; the PAN-1988 note plane stays journal-only.
- Do not add a transition guard to the relay trigger at review-status.ts:519 in addition to the durable anchor.

autoDecisions.summary: Verdict anchor is sha256(issueId + head anchor + trimmed notes), truncated to 32 hex chars, where the head anchor is reviewedAtCommit ?? prHeadSha ?? 'no-head'.
autoDecisions.rationale: Including the notes means a re-verdict at the same commit carrying NEW evidence relays exactly once more, which is correct because the agent is being told something it has not been told. Unbounded re-relay is bounded by the cycle cap, not by the anchor.

autoDecisions.summary: Convergence rule is a plain cap: UAT_CONVERGENCE_MAX_CYCLES = 3, not-converging at 3 or more recorded entries.
autoDecisions.rationale: UAT emits no countable finding series, so review's reversal/stall arithmetic has no input. Because anchor dedup means a repeated identical verdict never appends a cycle, every recorded entry is by construction a distinct verdict, and three distinct failed UAT verdicts without a pass is a loop a human should see.

autoDecisions.summary: Cycle recording and gate evaluation live at the write-door delivery path (deliverUatFailureToWorkAgentHostSide), not in journal reconcile.
autoDecisions.rationale: ReviewStatusReconcileHooks carries no UAT delivery — the only UAT delivery site is setReviewStatusSync:519 — so review's reconcile-based placement does not transfer.

autoDecisions.summary: Unstick of a uat-not-converging gate reuses the existing whole-lifecycle reset and additionally clears uatStatus, uatNotes, uatCycleHistory and uatFeedbackAnchor.
autoDecisions.rationale: A scoped reset preserving a green review would be cheaper but would make two convergence gates behave differently on the same operator button; consistency with the PAN-3151 contract wins.

autoDecisions.summary: A notesless failed UAT verdict is rejected by a typed write-door throw, translated to HTTP 400 at the routes, a non-zero CLI exit, and a skip-plus-nudge in the deacon recovery patrol.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue explicitly asks for a hard error at the write door, and a verdict that blocks the merge queue must carry its reason. The patrol alone gets a soft path because a throw there would abort the loop over every other issue.

autoDecisions.summary: Migration v65 backfills legacy uat_status='failed' rows with blank notes with an explicit LEGACY_UAT_NOTES_MARKER string.
autoDecisions.rationale: restoreReviewStatusFromRecords re-writes historical verdicts through the write door; without the backfill a cache rebuild would throw on any pre-PAN-3580 notesless failure. The marker names itself as legacy so it is never mistaken for real evidence.

autoDecisions.summary: The two new UAT fields are both mirrored into the per-issue record and restored from it, unlike reviewCycleHistory which is mirrored only.
autoDecisions.rationale: Surviving a SQLite cache rebuild is the entire point of a durable delivery identity; a column alone is wiped by the rebuild it is supposed to survive.

items.title: Add the pure UAT convergence module (anchor, cap, evaluator)

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/cloister/uat-convergence.ts in the style of its sibling src/lib/cloister/review-convergence.ts — file-header comment naming PAN-3580, named exports, no I/O. Export interface UatCycleEntry { cycle: number; anchor: string; atCommit?: string; recordedAt: string }, const UAT_CONVERGENCE_MAX_CYCLES = 3, uatVerdictAnchor({ issueId, headAnchor, notes }) returning createHash('sha256').update(`${issueId.toUpperCase()} ${headAnchor?.trim() || 'no-head'} ${notes?.trim() ?? ''}`).digest('hex').slice(0, 32), and evaluateUatConvergence(entries) returning 'not-converging' when entries.length >= UAT_CONVERGENCE_MAX_CYCLES else 'converging'. See PRD section 5 WI-1 for the exact snippet. Do NOT port evaluateReviewConvergence's reversal/stall arithmetic.
